about: The subtitles a title starts with when no memory of its series decides: StartSubtitles of Mira.Core (Windows and Mac, for a conversion and for mpv playing the file) and TrackChoice of the iPhone. order: the settings' subtitle languages; audio: the language of the audio playing (null: not said); subtitles: the file's, in its order (lang null: not said). expected: the position of the subtitles to show, null for none, "player" where the player keeps its own choice (mpv's, Jellyfin's default on iPhone).
